question.text: Per Section 2.2.2(A), approximately what proportion of the 1.8 lakh tax-exempt NPOs (as of 2018) had obtained FCRA funding, and what proportion had obtained CSR funding?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 2.2.2(A), 'As of 2018, there were only 1.8 lakh institutions who had registered and claimed tax exemption status. Among them, only about 12% had obtained FCRA funding, and only 11% had obtained CSR funding. The number is even lower for grants from government schemes.' This illustrates the concentration of institutional funding among a small subset. **The Trap:** Option A overestimates access. Option C grossly overestimates. Option D underestimates — the 12%/11% figures are the chapter's exact numbers. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXIV / IFSCA-01 (AML) treats FCRA overlap. V-A (MF Distributor) treats CSR donor-side. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** In your pre-engagement due diligence, check your NPO client's FCRA and CSR eligibility — the 12%/11% statistic shows that most NPOs DON'T have these — and if your client does, note it as a positive factor but also audit the compliance trail (FCRA annual returns, CSR Form CSR-2 filings).
